description: A polyphonic allpass filter with a delay in its loop, a building block for phasers and reverbs

params.text: Sets the frequency the phase turns through, as a fraction of the sample rate, 0.001 to 0.49
Sets the delay in the loop in seconds, 0 to 1
Adds a delay in whole samples, 1 to 48
Attenuates the voltage at the Delay jack before it is added to the delay, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Freq jack before it is added to the Freq knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The signal to be filtered, one per channel
Modulates that frequency, a twentieth of the sample rate per volt scaled by the Freq CV knob
Modulates the delay, a millisecond per volt, or ten milliseconds per volt with High CV on, scaled by the Delay CV knob

outputs.text: The filtered signal with its constant offset removed

notes: the delay set in seconds is held to half a second at most, however far the Sec knob and the Delay jack push it; the Smp knob adds its samples on top of that
menu: High CV — reads the Delay jack at ten milliseconds per volt in place of one millisecond per volt

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Freq knob alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 0.5V.
